You are one role in an autonomous ML research agent for KuaiRand-Pure.
The immutable task is within-user ranking of long_view using validation GAUC and nDCG@5.
Use train and validation only. Never request or infer hidden-test information. Do not change
the official evaluator, split, label, budgets, or reference files. Return only the requested
structured output. Evidence must be attributable to a supplied method card or primary source.
Every role response is parsed as JSON; never return Markdown, commentary, or text outside the
single requested JSON object.

EDA roles produce compact planning/report artifacts only. They do not generate candidate.py,
modify raw data, change evaluators, or inspect hidden-test data. Prefer train-only evidence
and leakage-safe feature hypotheses compatible with registered families: bpr, group_softmax, history_features, multi_task.

## Data Quality

- 239 videos with zero duration (24,076 train rows affected)
- 15,609 exact duplicate rows in the training-period log
- Sentinel: is_live_streamer = -124 on 21,127 of 27,285 user rows
- UNKNOWN values: user_active_degree (6), video_type (1), upload_type (80)
- Constant columns: is_lowactive_period, visible_status, is_rand
- hourmin encodes hour times 100 in UTC+8
- The training-period log begins on 20220409, not 20220408

## Feature Coverage

- Video features: 100.000 % of train+valid video IDs found in the feature table
- User features: 100.000 % of train+valid user IDs found in the profile table

## Leakage Flag

The video statistics table is a period aggregate over full-platform traffic.
Implied total shows: 12.83 B vs 2.62 M logged
exposures (ratio approximately 4,892 to one). Observation periods per video
range 45 to 181, exceeding the interaction log span.
Legal for use, but any feature derived from it must be caveated as leaky.

## Metric Conventions

- Task: within-user ranking (each user's impressions ranked against each other)
- nDCG@5: sorts by score with a stable sort (ties fall back to row order)
- AUC: averages ranks over ties (Mann-Whitney U)
- GAUC: per-user AUC, only users with 0 < positives < impressions,
  weighted by positive count
- Zero-positive users: nDCG recorded as 0.0 and included in the average
- Primary score = mean(GAUC, nDCG@5)

## Measured Dead Ends

- Adding all 13 static feature fields: primary 0.5940 vs 0.5950 for the default 5
- Embedding dimension k = 8 / 16 / 32: primary 0.5895 / 0.5902 / 0.5887 (flat)
- The bottleneck is not features or capacity
- First-order user-only terms contribute exactly 0 to within-user ranking
  (any term constant within a user does not change intra-group ordering)


ROLE: EDA Builder
Produce a compact UI-visible EDA and feature-engineering report from this plan.
You may infer only from the supplied DATA CARD and experiment history; do not invent exact statistics that are not present.
Separate observations from implications. Every feature candidate must state implementation scope and leakage risk.
Favor feature candidates compatible with src.models.features, history_features, multi_task, BPR, or group_softmax.
Return concise JSON: at most 3 findings, 3 feature candidates, and 3 UI notes. One sentence per field.

feature_candidates.description: Bucket video duration into intervals with an explicit zero/NA bucket, fed as an item-side categorical embedding.
feature_candidates.expected_impact: Captures non-linear duration effects and stabilizes zero-duration rows; likely improves long_view ranking.
feature_candidates.implementation_scope: Preprocess video feature table once; map duration to bucket id; add to item embedding lookup in model config.
feature_candidates.leakage_risk: Low; duration is a static video property, not a period aggregate.
feature_candidates.name: duration_bucket_na

feature_candidates.description: Per-video long_view/finish propensity computed only from train log exposures, normalized by duration to mitigate popularity bias.
feature_candidates.expected_impact: Strong item-side signal for within-user ranking if computed on train-only and carefully normalized.
feature_candidates.implementation_scope: Compute from train interactions with deduplication; join to video table and add as scalar item feature; validate on valid only.
feature_candidates.leakage_risk: Low if strictly train-only; high if using the leaky full-platform statistics table.
feature_candidates.name: train_only_video_longview_finish_rate

feature_candidates.description: Train-only user past long_view rate within video category or upload type, forming a user-category affinity feature.
feature_candidates.expected_impact: Personalizes category preference and improves ranking for users with stable past behavior.
feature_candidates.implementation_scope: Aggregate train log by user and video category to obtain ratio counts; use as auxiliary interaction feature outside main tab embedding.
feature_candidates.leakage_risk: Low if computed only from train rows and no validation-period data is used.
feature_candidates.name: user_history_category_longview_ratio

findings.implication: Tab should be a conditioning variable or used for negative sampling in BPR/group_softmax to reduce exposure bias.
findings.observation: Tab 4 has long_view rate 48.93% and tab 0 has 4.22%, with tab 1 at 38.61%, so intra-user tab context is highly discriminative.
findings.title: Tab strongly stratifies long_view

findings.implication: Duration-derived features must include an explicit NA/zero bucket rather than imputing or dropping these rows.
findings.observation: 239 videos have zero duration, affecting 24,076 train rows and creating a distinct missing/zero category.
findings.title: Zero-duration videos distort duration features

findings.implication: Features derived from it may encode future signals; use only with explicit leakage caveats or rely on train-only aggregates.
findings.observation: The video statistics table reflects full-platform aggregates over periods beyond the log span, with exposure ratio about 4,892:1 vs logged data.
findings.title: Video statistics table is leaky period aggregate

data.recommended_next_focus: Run a BPR/group_softmax ablation adding duration bucket plus train-only user-history category affinity, conditioning negatives by tab, while keeping all statistics features train-only.
data.summary: EDA plan focuses on tab-stratified long_view by duration, zero-duration NA handling, train-only user-history propensities, and caveated video-stats features. BPR/group_softmax families should condition on tab and use deduplicated train rows.
